options.name: HEADLINER READ
options.description: Correctly predict the main-event winner.

options.name: BANKER LOCK
options.description: Choose one fighter you are certain will win. They must win.
options.selection_prompt: Choose one fighter as your Banker

options.name: EXACT SCRIPT
options.description: Choose a fighter, win method and exact round; all must be correct.

options.name: FINISH LOCK
options.description: Choose one fight you are certain will end before a decision.

options.name: METHOD CYCLE
options.description: Build a 3-leg combo: one KO/TKO, one submission and one decision; all must win.
options.selection_prompt: Choose one KO, one SUB and one DEC winner

options.name: METHOD PAIR
options.description: Build a 2-fighter combo using different win methods; both must be correct.

options.name: FINISH DOUBLE
options.description: Choose 2 fights; both must end in a finish.

options.name: THREE FINISHES
options.description: The card must contain at least 3 finishes.

options.name: PICK A LANE
options.description: Choose FINISHES or DECISIONS. Your side must be at least as common on the card; a tie also completes the mission.

options.name: EXACT FINISH COUNT
options.description: Choose the exact number of finishes that will occur on the card.
